[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] '''Wylla''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]]. At some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, Wylla hired a group of agents to purchase some [[Nerf steak/Legends|nerf steaks]] from [[Davengatt's Double-Zed Nerf Ranch]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Engebo V]]. She provided the agents with a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and insisted that they deliver the steaks to her within three days of picking them up, so as to preserve the steaks' freshness.
